_meta.project: instex Instrument Explorer -- TELESCOPES mode: Magellan I (Baade) and Magellan II (Clay) 6.5 m, Las Campanas -- every focus and the entrance-pupil geometry
_meta.companion: data/telescopes/magellan.md (same content as Markdown). Structure follows data/imaging/widefield.json: sources{key: cite, file, url}; common (params shared by the twin telescopes); per telescope: title, telescope (machine-readable object with primary, pupil and a foci list; every value points to sourced params through refs), params, not_found, conflicts, notes.
_meta.rule: Every value carries src (key into sources), loc and a short verbatim quote from a document saved unmodified under rawdata/telescopes/magellan/, or an existing file already used by data/imaging/reimagers.json or magellan.json (keys LCOT, CS98N9, BD03, D11, LCOUM, M18, FSCDR, P13, L26, M15, M06, F04, S12C, MCM, LCOMI reused, same files). derived = arithmetic done here (shown). alternatives = other sourced values (conflicts). NOT FOUND marks a gap; INFERRED marks a reasoned guess that no source states. Nothing is filled from memory.
_meta.quote_normalisation: Unicode NFKC; curly quotes, primes, dashes, minus, multiplication sign, degree glyphs normalised; whitespace collapsed (a quote also passes with all whitespace removed and/or hyphenated line breaks joined); " ... " joins non-adjacent pieces. Text from pdftotext -layout and -raw per page (PDF p. = page index of the saved PDF), tag-stripped HTML and raw source, raw and decoded ADS/Confluence JSON, .py as is.
_meta.pupil_frame: Vane coordinates are in the hcipy make_magellan_aperture frame (metres on the primary, angle from +x, each vane a half-line from start_xy outward). The orientation of this frame relative to the telescope elevation axis is not documented.
_meta.refs: Telescope-object refs name params as common.<id>, baade.<id> or clay.<id>.
_meta.check_result: 146 quotes checked against the saved files, 0 failures (2026-10-19)

Clay vane area 2 x 2.330 x 0.01905 + 2 x 2.330 x 0.0381 = 0.266 m^2 = 0.88% of the 30.39 m^2 annulus; all four at 0.75 in: 0.178 m^2 = 0.58%. conflicts: Central obscuration: 29% diameter ratio (MXP51, M18, L26, HCI; Clay) vs "~5% obscuration" of the area (MM19). 0.29^2 = 8.4% of the area; 5% (eps 0.22) matches the bare ~1.4 m secondary, not the 1.885 m baffle.
f/11 focal length: 71,526.4 mm (CS98N9 design, f/11.004) vs f/11.02 = 71,630 mm (MXPA1, Clay Zemax) vs 0.347 mm/" = 71,574 mm (P04, rounded) vs 2.88"/mm = 71,620 mm (FSCDR, rounded).
f/11 secondary: 1.3 m (MXPA1) vs 1.36 m beam footprint (MXP51) vs ~1.41 m (MM19, implied).
Corrected f/11 field: 30' (CS98N9, S94, D11) with slight vignetting beyond 24' (BD03, LCOT); IMACS sees 0% vignetting to R = 12' and 9% (LCOUM) / ~10% (LCOUM f/2 section) at R = 15'.
Spider widths: 0.75 in and 1.5 in (MXP51, HCI) = 1.905 and 3.81 cm; C18X rounds the first to 1.9 cm.
notes: Terminology: the three center-section f/11 ports are called "auxiliary" (LCOT, G16), "folded" (FSCDR, SCH03, FIREM), "auxiliary Nasmyth" (D11), "folded Cassegrain" (LL20) and AUX1-AUX3 / "folded port 2" (CMAGE, MG08). MagAO calls its Nasmyth station the "folded Nasmyth port (NAS)" (MZ14).
Reflections: 3 to every f/11 station (M1, M2, flat M3); 2 at the Clay f/5 Cassegrain (M15 "two aluminum reflections"); 3 at the MagAO F/16 station (M1, ASM, M3).

The f/11 Gregorian ratio was chosen to match the IMACS collimator field curvature (param gregorian_ratio_choice); the Gregorian images the pupil in front of the secondary, which the IMACS flat-field screen exploits (param gregorian_pupil_image).
